- **Gray Mold**: Ghost spots (small whitish rings) on red tomatoes — not matching.
- **Rhizopus Soft Rots**: Completely collapsed/watery rot — not matching.
- **Phytophthora Blight**: Shriveled pepper collapse — not matching.
- **Bacterial Canker**: Bird's-eye spots on green tomato — not matching.
- **TSWV**: Brown necrotic areas on pale green tomatoes — not matching.

The defining feature in the test image — black acervuli with radiating setae on ripe tomato fruit — is diagnostic for Anthracnose (Colletotrichum). No other class in this set produces this type of dark, spiny fungal fruiting body on fruit.
